product.name: 3D Viewer — Product
product.paragraph: By default the model comes from the product metafield custom.model_3d (managed via the 3D Viewer app). Leave the override blank for the normal flow. Only paste a direct .glb / .gltf URL below if you want to override the metafield for testing.

model_url.label: Manual model URL (must end in .glb or .gltf)
model_url.info: Leave empty to use the product metafield. Non-model URLs are ignored.

page.name: 3D Viewer — Any Model
page.paragraph: Use either a Model ID or a file URL. The Model ID also applies that model's saved viewer settings, so it's the better option — copy it from the app under 3D Models → (your model) → Model ID.

model_id.label: Model ID
model_id.info: From the app's 3D Models library. Takes priority over the URL below.

model_url.label: Model URL (.glb / .gltf)
model_url.info: Alternative to a Model ID: paste a direct file URL from Settings → Files.

configurator_block.name: Product configurator
configurator_block.paragraph: Shows the product's 3D model with the customer options set up in the 3D editor, live pricing and add to cart.
